    AI Overview
    The 2026 Malcolm in the Middle reboot, titled Life's Still Unfair, is a four-episode Hulu limited series starring original cast members Frankie Muniz (Malcolm), Bryan Cranston (Hal), Jane Kaczmarek (Lois), Justin Berfield (Reese), and Christopher Masterson (Francis). It focuses on a grown-up Malcolm, now a father, returning for his parents' 40th anniversary. 
    Key Cast Details 
    • Returning Family: Frankie Muniz (Malcolm), Jane Kaczmarek (Lois), Bryan Cranston (Hal), Christopher Masterson (Francis), and Justin Berfield (Reese) return to their iconic roles.
    • New/Replaced Roles: Caleb Ellsworth-Clark plays the adult Dewey (replacing Erik Per Sullivan).
    • New Family/Characters: Anthony Timpano appears as Jamie, Vaughan Murrae as new sibling Kelly, and Keeley Karsten plays Malcolm's daughter, Leah.
    • Supporting Cast: Emy Coligado returns as Piama, along with appearances from Craig Lamar Traylor (Stevie Kenarban). 
    The series is created by original creator Linwood Boomer and brings back key behind-the-scenes talent, including director Ken Kwapis.

    AI Overview
    The Malcolm in the Middle reboot, Life’s Still Unfair, is a four-episode limited series premiering on Disney+ (and Hulu) on April 10, 2026, featuring the return of original stars Frankie Muniz (Malcolm), Bryan Cranston (Hal), Jane Kaczmarek (Lois), Justin Berfield (Reese), and Christopher Masterson (Francis). 
    Watch the official teaser for the series to see the cast back in action:
    01:25
    TODAY
    YouTube• Dec 30, 2025
    Key Returning Cast & Details: 
    Frankie Muniz (Malcolm): Now a parent, struggling to deal with his own family. 
    Bryan Cranston & Jane Kaczmarek (Hal & Lois): Reprising their roles as the parents. 
    Justin Berfield (Reese) & Chris Masterson (Francis): The older brothers are returning, with the story focusing on them coming together for Hal and Lois's 40th wedding anniversary. 
    Emy Coligado: Returns as Francis's wife, Piama. 
    Character Changes: 
    • Erik Per Sullivan (Dewey): Did not return, opting out of acting to focus on academic pursuits.
    • Recasting: The role of Dewey is recast with actor Caleb Ellsworth-Clark. 
    The revival, shot in spring 2025, sees original creator Ken Kwapis returning to direct, with the storyline following Malcolm after he is forced back into his chaotic family's life.
